title: Java Script Array map()
text:
JavaScript
Array map()



The map() Method

The
map()
method creates a new array with the results of calling a function for every array element.

map() in React

When using
map()
in React to create list items, each item needs a unique
key

map() with Objects

You can also use
map()
with arrays of objects:

map() Parameters

The
map()
method takes three parameters:

currentValue
- The current element being processed

index
- The index of the current element (optional)

array
- The array that map was called upon (optional)

Note:
The
map()
method always returns a new array. It does not modify the original array.
